hooks.name: Typecheck and Tests After Task Completion
hooks.description: After Kiro completes a spec task, run TypeScript typecheck and all tests. If either fails, Kiro receives the output and can correct the issue before marking the task done.

action.command: cd /Users/juanhoyos/proyectos/kiro-university/backend && echo "=== TypeScript typecheck ===" && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TYPECHECK: OK" && echo "=== Tests ===" && npm test && echo "TESTS: OK" 2>&1
